title: Should AI Mimic People? Understanding AI-Supported Writing Technology Among Black Users

bias_targets.methodology: Remote moderated user observations and semi-structured interviews where participants wrote using African American Vernacular English (AAVE) to evaluate how AI writing tools (Google Docs, ChatGPT) incorrectly flag, over-correct, or poorly mimic their natural dialect.

Qualitative thematic analysis of interviews with Black American users to understand their lived experiences, perceptions of structural exclusion, and feelings of alienation when interacting with NLP technologies.

Interview-based evaluation exploring users' apprehensions regarding cultural erasure, misrepresentation, stereotyping, and the failure of AI models to recognize culturally specific names and expressions.
